nodes.svg_description: Solid white rounded rectangle (approx. 44px corner radius) centered on the canvas, serving as a card area.

nodes.asset_description: Set of flat, hand-drawn science doodles with transparent background positioned around the white card: (1) A tilted transparent beaker near the top-left of the card containing blue liquid with bubbles and black measuring ticks; glass body light blue (#b9d2f5) with darker blue liquid (#6aa7e8) and navy outline (#2e4057). (2) A yellow test tube with cream rim at the top-right, partly filled with golden liquid (#f2c14e), small black dashes on the glass, navy outline (#2e4057). (3) A vertical battery on the mid-left with pink upper half (#ef6f88), yellow lower half (#f5c14c), white plus/minus symbols, navy outline. (4) A diagonal dropper near the lower-left pointing down-right with pink bulb (#e86a7a), beige stem (#f3e0c8), blue liquid inside transitioning from teal (#29a3c6) to mid-blue (#1f78b4) and a single falling blue drop, navy outline. (5) Bottom-center safety goggles with white frames and pale-blue lenses (#d7e6fb) with reflections and navy outline. (6) Bottom-right molecule model: yellow (#f4b73e) and light green (#96d4a7) spheres connected by red-orange rods (#e56b55) with small highlights; all elements have hand-drawn uneven strokes.
